app.name: OrderPilot
app.tagline: AI reads, rules decide, people approve.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.description: Search for an area or an action.
palette.placeholder: Type an area or an action

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyHint: Reminders and approval requests will appear here when workflows are built.

demo.switcherHint: Switch to another role to see its home page.

login.title: Sign in to OrderPilot
login.subtitle: Use your work email and password.
login.demoHint: Pick a role to look around with synthetic data. No password is needed.
login.optionsFailed: The demo sign-in could not be checked. You can still sign in with your email.

sessionEnded.title: Your session ended
sessionEnded.description: Sign in again to carry on. This page stays as you left it, and anything you typed is kept.

errors.network: OrderPilot could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.contract: The server sent an answer this version of the app does not understand.

codes.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some of the details are not valid.
codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is not right.
codes.REFRESH_REUSED: Your session was closed for your safety. Sign in again.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You do not have access to this.
codes.CSRF_INVALID: The request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
codes.DEMO_MODE_DISABLED: The demo sign-in is switched off.
codes.CONFLICT: Someone else changed this first. Reload and try again.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE: A connected system is not answering. Try again soon.
codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server had a problem. Try again, and quote the trace ID if it continues.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you asked for does not exist or has moved.

forbidden.title: You do not have access
forbidden.description: Your role does not include this area. If you think it should, ask a system admin.

crash.title: Something went wrong
crash.description: This page hit an error. Quote the trace ID if you ask for help.

home.atAGlanceHint: Counts appear as each area is built.
home.noCues: No tiles for your role yet.
home.listsEmptyHint: Task lists, recent orders and documents for your role arrive with their areas.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: How OrderPilot looks and who you are signed in as.
settings.appearanceHint: Choose a theme. System follows your device.
settings.name: Name
